text.ar:
🗳️ الجمعة 18 ديسمبر موعدنا في نادي طنطا الرياضي
صوتي لقائمة المهندس حسين داود .. وانت معانا؟
تاريخ نحترمه .. ومستقبل نصنعه 💛💙
اتعرّف على المرشحين الـ12 وبرنامج القائمة هنا 👇
{url}
📣 وتابع الحملة الرسمية على فيسبوك:
https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596208629223

copyright.ar: © 2026 قائمة المهندس حسين داود. جميع الحقوق محفوظة.

todo: videos: none yet. The leader's word (home) and the 12 interviews (home carousel) show as "قريبًا" placeholders on text-free posters (media/<slug>-poster.jpg, tools/video-posters.mjs); give each its "src" in elections.json and drop "placeholder" to make it play. Program-file clips stay hidden until sent.
vision page (/vision/, template vision, elections.json vision): Ahmed's text, three typos fixed (ثقفي، مساحات الخضراء، المهارت); linked from the home hero only.

program files: seven (المالي والحوكمة، التطوير، الاستثمار والتسويق، الطبي، التحول الرقمي، الأمني والإداري، الرياضي). 21 Nov: each file page shows its plan (elections.json files[].plan, FilePlan.astro): text word for word from five candidates' papers, no names, sorted by file (source and choices: program-files-text.md). Investment and marketing (3) and digital (2) have no paper of their own yet. The one-line taglines are ours (placeholders: confirm). The old /files/services and /files/culture redirect to /files/. File leads (elections.json files[].leads; on the file cards and under each file page's title), from the client's strategy sheet «الرؤية الاستراتيجية لنادي طنطا 2026–2030» (21 Nov): finance Afify; development Attia; investment Abu El-Azm and Ashoush; medical Mabrouk; digital Sweilem; security Sedky and El-Sharkawy; sports Selim, Hamza and El-Menshawy. The sheet titles two files «المالية والحوكمة» and «الأمن والإداري»; the site keeps the client's earlier titles (المالي والحوكمة، الأمني والإداري): confirm.
election: Friday 18 December 2026 at 9:00 AM Cairo time (from Ahmed). The countdown runs to that moment; from then the day's message shows.
membership number rule (6 digits) is the template's; confirm Tanta's format.

social: Facebook only, the campaign page https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596208629223 (short form of its /people/… address). It is in the footer, the search data (sameAs) and every WhatsApp message (support.share.messages and headerCta.text), always AFTER the site link: WhatsApp builds the preview from the first link, so the preview stays the website's.

support page: no sign-up any more (Ahmed's call). It is a WhatsApp share kit (elections.json support.share: three ready messages linking to the home page, a live chat preview, share and copy buttons); the link preview is media/share.jpg, made by tools/share-card.mjs. Complaints: for now the form opens WhatsApp to 01000083751 with the message written (elections.json complaints.whatsapp; the member presses Send, photos go in the chat). Next: automatic sending through the WhatsApp Cloud API (api.mode live), see API.md.
El-Sharkawy (اللواء مصطفى الشرقاوي; first read from the poster as الشمقاوي; the old /team/mostafa-el-shamkawy/ redirects): CV in (18 Nov; address, phone and email left out).

leader: CV in, age shown (51, from his CV; Ahmed's call). Company cards: StyleHome, Kleek, Tanta Modern School, Syncology (Friends taken off the cards by Ahmed; it stays in the bio). Logos from the media agent. Each card links to the company's site (elections.json url): stylehome-egypt.com, kleekdevelopments.com, tms-egypt.com, syncology.tech.
seats: from the campaign poster (via the media agent). Ballot numbers are the official ones (the club's candidate lists, numbered per seat), set 18 Nov.
names: Fathy Selim is د. (Ahmed, matching the poster; his bio keeps his popular name كابتن فتحي سليم); the poster spells the leader 'داود'.

photos: client photos cut out by the media agent. 18 Nov: Ahmed caught a mix-up: the photo shown as Mabrouk was Karim Abu El-Azm (now Karim's card), and the grey-suit photo shown as Karim is nobody on the list (removed). The three photos shown as El-Sharkawy were someone else too (removed). Mabrouk and El-Sharkawy are cut out of the stadium poster (the only source): closer head-and-shoulders framing, real pixels only; neighbours' sleeves removed (media agent, second pass), a small jaw seam on El-Sharkawy blended. Crest: the media agent's 3D version (v2, 18 Nov) (crest.webp with shadow on blue: hero, page bands, ballot card, share cards; logo.webp without shadow: header, favicon, schema logo). The club's original file would still be the best source.

seo: Google Search Console is verified by DNS (TXT record in Cloudflare, so seo.googleSiteVerification stays empty) and /sitemap.xml is submitted. Cloudflare Web Analytics is on. The election's place carries the club's street address, postcode and map point (from the club's site tantasc.net and OpenStreetMap).

design: 20 Nov, the client's agent's design applied to every page hero (navy #15396A, gold #D2A24C, cream #FAF6EF; palette royal-blue keeps its name because the live build selects it): gold ribbons (GoldWave), the club gate pale on the left (list.backdrop, club-gate.webp: our quick clean-up until the media agent's enhanced photo), gold pill, the leader's name in gold (hero.titleAccent), hero buttons as cards with gold icon tabs (hero.actions[].icon). Spotlights, roof lines and the brass gate kept. Link previews remade in navy and gold: media/share.jpg (tools/share-card.mjs) and each candidate's <slug>-share.jpg (tools/candidate-share-cards.mjs).
